what: PR #120 CodeQL path injection findings in recovery/evidence probes
expected: CLI arguments cannot select evidence write locations or inject path separators into historical log names.
observed: Before the fix the real probe created a caller-selected directory and the archived phase expression returned traversal input unchanged.
root_cause: The recovery probe passed argv[3] through resolve into mkdir and multiple writeFile calls, and called realpath(argv[2]) before establishing its temporary-root boundary. The archived probe interpolated argv[2] without restricting phases.
fixed_by: Allocate evidence with mkdtemp instead of accepting an output path; normalize/check the temporary app boundary before realpath and validate the canonical result; select archived phases from literal before/after/smoke returns. Run regressions in the CI security suite. Native ordinary/prepared recovery matrices and prepush passed.

invariants: Evidence directories are freshly created and owned by the probe
External, sibling-prefix, temporary-root and escaping symlink app arguments are rejected
Archived log phases are literal before/after/smoke values
Ordinary and prepared reload recovery, previous-generation HTTP and joined shutdown still work

environment.target: Owned temporary fixtures, Bun 1.3.10 on macOS
environment.monitoring: Native test output and CLI generation/shutdown logs; GitHub CodeQL alerts 80-84 identify the five reviewed sinks. No external application monitoring applies to these test scripts.

reproduction: Run focused path tests against the original branch and observe both assertions fail
Replay the native probe with a caller-selected output directory and observe the directory created before rejection
Replay the same tests, then run both ordinary and prepared full HTTP recovery matrices and prepush

before.note: Actual native probe creates caller-selected output

after.note: All three security regressions pass, including boundary cases
Same native scenario rejects output selection without creating it
Real CLI, HTTP, both startup paths, environment/source cycles and joined cleanup
Required prepush gate command and native exit status

before.assertion: Path boundaries reject unsafe arguments before filesystem writes

after.assertion: Path boundaries reject unsafe arguments before filesystem writes

runtime.reason: The defects concern standalone test-script argv/filesystem handling, with no exposed API
runtime.boundary: Native Bun recovery probe invocation -> argument validation -> actual temporary filesystem
dependencies: Actual filesystem; owned minimal temporary fixture
steps: Invoke real probe with caller-selected evidence directory
Assert nonzero exit and no evidence directory creation

before.assertion: Path boundaries reject unsafe arguments before filesystem writes

after.assertion: Path boundaries reject unsafe arguments before filesystem writes

regressions.boundary: Native Bun recovery probe invocation -> argument validation -> actual temporary filesystem
regressions.assertion: Path boundaries reject unsafe arguments before filesystem writes

regressions.boundary: bun dev -> supervisor -> compiler/environment resolution -> runtime HTTP -> joined shutdown
regressions.assertion: All ordinary and prepared environment/source recovery and shutdown assertions pass

limitations: The archived probe contains historical machine-specific setup and moved imports. Its actual phase declaration is extracted with the TypeScript parser and evaluated directly for all accepted phases and traversal inputs; the entire historical app experiment is not rerun.
Native runtime replay uses a disposable cloned installed minimal app. The existing e-commerce preview is left running and is not edited.
GitHub CodeQL/CI results are checked separately on the published final commit; no alerts are dismissed or scanning rules disabled.

notes: Historical before/after application logs remain unchanged; only the executable archived probe phase selection is hardened.

Regression tests were initially authored under packages/cli/tests/dev-environment/paths.test.ts, then moved to tests/security/dev-recovery-probe-paths.test.ts so the standard CI security gate executes them.
